verdict.rationale: Pika documents its own still-to-motion capability: Pikaframes animates between up to five stills with Pika 2.5, and it can create clips from user references, so the core image-to-video function is first-party. However, the evidence is one-line marketing claims, and nothing addresses whether the subject and composition of the source image are preserved. Missing for 10: explicit single-image-to-video documentation, evidence of subject and composition fidelity, independent or hands-on corroboration.
